newsitem.title: CANADA: NAV Canada sets two bonds totalling C$750 mln.
newsitem.headline: NAV Canada sets two bonds totalling C$750 mln.

text.p: NAV Canada, the newly privatized national air traffic authority, issued two bonds totalling C$750 million, the lead manager said on Friday.

It issued a C$500 million 7.56 percent bond due March 1, 2027 at a price of C$99.952 to yield 7.564 percent for a spread of 38 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.0 percent bond due 2023, RBC Dominion Securities said.
It also issued a C$250 million 6.45 percent bond due June 1, 2004 at a price of C$99.937 to yield 6.459 percent, 18 basis points over the Government of Canada bond due 2004, RBC Dominion said.
Both bonds will be dated and delivered on March 24.
The C$500 million bond will pay interest September 1 and March 1 and the C$250 million bond will on June 1 and December 1.
